context:
Pattern: identify the if/elif chain, extract the mapping as a module-level dict constant
(UPPER_SNAKE_CASE), replace the chain with a single dict.get() or dict[] lookup.
Raise the same exception on KeyError that the original raised on else/fallthrough.

Reference: benchbox/core/tpcds_obt/query_conversion.py already uses this pattern in
other functions (_post_process dispatch) - follow that style.
description:
8 functions have high cyclomatic complexity caused purely by if/elif chains performing
data lookups. These are the simplest category to fix: replace the chain with a module-level
dict constant and a single lookup. No logic changes, no API changes, just data vs code
separation.

Target functions:
  benchbox/core/tpcds_obt/query_conversion.py:_update_role_map        (19)
  benchbox/core/tpcds_obt/query_conversion.py:_table_from_prefix      (18)
  benchbox/core/tpcds/maintenance_test.py:_map_to_maintenance_operation_type (15)
  benchbox/cli/exceptions.py:_handle_cli_error                        (15)
  benchbox/release/content_validation.py:_is_example_line             (15)
  benchbox/utils/database_naming.py:_get_optimizations_suffix         (15)
  benchbox/core/metadata_primitives/generator.py:_find_objects_with_prefix (16)
  benchbox/cli/composite_params.py:parse                              (18, partial)

Expected outcome: all 8 functions drop below warn threshold (15).

anti_patterns.dont: change function signatures or return types
merge separate dict constants into a single mega-dict
refactor surrounding functions beyond the target chain
use lambdas in dict values when the original used inline expressions; keep readable

preserves.behavior: _handle_cli_error: all existing error types must still trigger the same help output
_map_to_maintenance_operation_type: mapping must be exact (drives TPC-DS maintenance spec)
_table_from_prefix: column prefix → table mapping must be 100% accurate (drives OBT SQL)
_update_role_map: role map output must be identical for all TPC-DS OBT queries
parse: CLI parameter parsing output must be byte-for-byte identical for all current inputs

verifications.description: All 8 target functions drop below warn threshold
verifications.expected: No WARN entries for the 8 target functions

work_units.notes:
Both are in query_conversion.py. _table_from_prefix has ~15-way if/elif → dict.
_update_role_map maps table names → role prefixes → dict constant TABLE_TO_ROLE_PREFIX.
The role inference calls after the lookup can stay; only the lookup changes.

benchbox/core/tpcds/maintenance_test.py - maps (operation, table) tuples to
MaintenanceOperationType. Simple dict: OPERATION_TABLE_TO_TYPE = {("INSERT", "t"): ...}

benchbox/cli/exceptions.py - 6+ isinstance() checks mapping error types to
help methods. Dict: ERROR_HANDLERS = {PlatformNotFoundError: ..., ...}
work_units.summary: Replace _handle_cli_error isinstance chain with dispatch dict

work_units.notes:
benchbox/release/content_validation.py - multiple if-checks for different
example patterns. Compile all patterns into EXAMPLE_PATTERNS = [re.compile(...), ...]
and use any(p.match(line) for p in EXAMPLE_PATTERNS).
work_units.summary: Replace _is_example_line multi-pattern checks with compiled regex list

work_units.notes:
_get_optimizations_suffix (database_naming.py): dict mapping (platform, opts) → suffix.
_find_objects_with_prefix (metadata_primitives/generator.py): SQL template dict keyed
by (object_type, dialect).

benchbox/cli/composite_params.py - key dispatch for sample/first/queries uses
if/elif; replace with TYPE_CONVERTERS = {"sample": float, "first": int, ...}.
Query special-case parsing (edge case) stays inline but extract to helper.
work_units.summary: Simplify composite_params.py:parse query/key dispatch with dict mapper
Run smoke tests and complexity check; verify all 8 functions below warn threshold
